era: PS2 rhythm / PSP port / modern PlayStation Classic
summary: Koei and iNiS's cult rhythm-adventure game, now available as a PS4/PS5 PlayStation 2 conversion, with the PSP Gitaroo Man Lives! port carrying the important exclusive content.

entries.title: Gitaroo Man
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 5 digital PlayStation 2 conversion plus PSP Gitaroo Man Lives! extras

emulation.emulator: Native PS5 digital PS2 conversion; PPSSPP for PSP extras
emulation.notes: Use PS5 for the main run and PPSSPP/PSP for the Gitaroo Man Lives! exclusive songs.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS5 output of the official PS2 conversion, with PSP extras capped by PSP/PPSSPP presentation.

primary.why: The 2026 PS4/PS5 digital release is the current official high-fidelity route for the original PS2 game, with modern PlayStation availability; PS5 is the preferred capture target.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS5 digital release for the main run. Use Gitaroo Man Lives! on PSP or PPSSPP for its exclusive Duet mode songs and PSP-specific extras.

secondary.exclusive_content: Gitaroo Man Lives! adds Duet mode with two exclusive songs, Metal Header and Toda Pasion, plus PSP-specific menus such as Jukebox and Theater mode.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the PSP port's Duet mode songs and inspect the Jukebox/Theater extras after the PS5 main run.
secondary.why: The PSP port adds Duet mode, two new songs, Jukebox, Theater mode, and easier/pausable changes.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS4/PS5 release is a PS2 conversion, and some content/functions may differ from the original PS2 version; the PSP port has exclusive content but lower fidelity.
